Command: No foreigner or hired servant shall eat the Passover
Summary: A foreigner merely passing through, and a hired servant, may not eat the Passover unless brought into the covenant household.
Commandment: No foreigner or hired servant shall eat the Passover.
Application: The moral/ceremonial/civil division is a traditional classification, not Scripture's own division; this law is traditionally classed as ceremonial. The rule guarded the covenant character of the meal; the stranger who joined the household by circumcision could eat (Exodus 12:48).
Purpose: Scripture's stated context: the meal is eaten in haste on the night of deliverance from Egypt, ready to depart (Exodus 12:11).
